data.long_meaning: Haushila is a beautiful and delightful name derived from Sanskrit. It is a feminine name that signifies grace, charm, and beauty. In Hindu mythology, Haushila is believed to be an embodiment of elegance and charm. The name Haushila carries the meaning “Graceful, Beautiful, Delightful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Haushila usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful, delightful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haushila total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: Haushila was a legendary king of the Vatsa dynasty, who ruled around 500 BC in the region of Bhojpur, present-day Bihar, India. He was known for his great patronage of the arts and learning, especially the Vedas and Jainism.

Haushila is also mentioned in the Buddhist texts, the Mahavamsa and Dipavamsa, as a generous donor to Buddhist monasteries. He is described as a friend of the Buddhist monk Mahinda, who brought Buddhism to Sri Lanka, and is said to have built a monastery for Mahinda at Anuradhapura, the ancient capital of Sri Lanka.
